name: Matt Burch
biography: Matt Burch is a Principal Security Researcher at Atredis Partners with 20 years of experience breaking things that aren't supposed to break. From the embedded components of ATM platforms to complex SCADA/OT environments, Matt specializes in identifying critical flaws in hardened, enterprise-class systems. He is best known for his research into ATM disk encryption and Mobile Device Management (MDM) security, some of which has been highlighted in Wired Magazine and presented at DEF CON 32. Matt is a reverse engineer and tool developer who has authored and contributed to various public projects. His career spans roles as an offensive security lead, expert witness, and technical advisor. Matt’s current research is a deep-dive into the ATM software supply chain, specifically targeting the subversion of TPM-backed roots of trust and the analysis of custom cryptographic primitives.
